description: This file contains the implementation of the Shipping class, which extends the core Model class and provides functionality to calculate total shipping costs in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes a method getTotal that adds shipping details to the order totals, considering shipping method, tax, and cost.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: A model class responsible for calculating and adding the shipping costs to the order total during checkout.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and appends the shipping cost to the totals array, considering shipping method, cost, and associated taxes.
